newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Nishat Mills first half profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: Nishat Mills first half profit seen up.

text.p: Pakistan's Nishat Mills Ltd first half results to March 31 was expected to rise sharply due to world wide textile demand and devaluation of the rupee, analysts said on Wednesday.

The first half after tax profit was likely to be 153 million rupees, 7.7 percent higher than the result of the full year ended September 30, 1996 of 142 million rupees, one analyst of Taurus Securities Ltd said on the eve of the announcement of the firm's first half results. The firm's 10-rupee stock fell 0.90 rupee to 21.85 on Tuesday at the Karachi Stock Exchange.
